items.plain_english: Meditation is oneself, the meditator is oneself, and the deity everywhere is oneself.

items.plain_english: It is all-knowing and all-full, and its own nature is indeed imperishable.

items.plain_english: It transcends illusion, is without support, pervading, and facing in all directions.

items.plain_english: It is not time, not the power of measurement, not Śiva, and not a sense-organ.

items.plain_english: It is indeed not taste, not happiness, and not suffering.

items.plain_english: It is not shadow, not heat, not cold, and not hot.

items.plain_english: No boundary is seen there, and indeed there is no sacred place or sectarian locus.

items.plain_english: For him there is no mother or father, no kinsman, and no deity.
